primary_sources.caption: Supplementary Tables 1–9 Supplementary Table 1. Harmonized metadata of samples analyzed. Supplementary Table 2. Cell Ranger QC outputs for all newly generated data. The table reports the magnitude of differential expression (log 2  fold change) and false discovery rate-adjusted  P  values using the Benjamini–Hochberg method. Supplementary Table 7. Reagents used for the snRNA-seq homogenization buffer. Supplementary Table 8. Reagents used for the snRNA-seq wash buffer. Supplementary Table 9. List of smFISH probes used for smFISH imagining.
